output.answer: Sysco’s latest reported annual revenue was $84.553 billion in fiscal 2026, the 52-week year ended June 27, 2026. Sysco’s August 4, 2026 results release rounds this to $84.6 billion and reports that it increased 3.9% year over year.
caveats: Sysco presents this top-line measure as “sales” in its financial statements; it is the company’s reported annual revenue measure.
This is the latest completed fiscal-year figure available as of 2026-11-11, rather than a calendar-year or subsequently estimated twelve-month figure.

output.question: What is Sysco's annual revenue?

key_facts.fact: Sysco reported fiscal 2026 sales of $84.553 billion for the year ended June 27, 2026.
Sysco reported that fiscal 2026 sales increased 3.9% to $84.6 billion.
